structured_output.analysis:
The budget is 403/128 = 3.1484 bits per weight, and iso_3.15 already uses 3.1480 (E514ab09c524e). Every upgrade therefore has to be paid for with a downgrade. Measured single-layer KL shows these upgrades give the largest gains:
- 14.down_proj from rht_gptq_int2 to rht_gptq_int3: 0.00633 → 0.00181 (E4c3f9b73e065, E90bd4b2f3645)
- 27.up_proj from gptq_int3 to gptq_int4: 0.00572 → 0.00217 (Ef04d8aa7bded, Efea8c18d2abc)
- 27.gate_proj from rht_gptq_int3 to rht_gptq_int4: 0.00499 → 0.00153 (Efa0bb391da67, Ef428ac081334)
- 3.up_proj from rht_gptq_int3 to gptq_int4: 0.00642 → 0.00238 (E6f4f7ea296d5, Ef4ee8cb4969e)

To pay for them I use the cheapest moves the analysis lists. Moving several o_proj layers and 7.gate_proj to 3-bit is predicted to cost only 1.4e-5 to 4.4e-5 KL each. Their record ids aren't given, so I can't cite those numbers. Neither the current methods of these layers nor the exact bit size of each method are given, so the budget arithmetic is approximate. I also don't know the sign convention for the predicted deltas. I assume a positive delta means a KL cost, so each move is a 4-bit to 3-bit downgrade that frees about 1 bit per weight. Each proposal frees more bits than it spends, to leave a margin. The predicted total (0.398) was well below the measured KL (0.436), so interactions between layers matter. For that reason the proposals range from small to large.

proposals.name: r1_down14_int3
proposals.rationale: Moving 14.down_proj from rht_gptq_int2 to rht_gptq_int3 lowers its single-layer KL from 0.00633 (E4c3f9b73e065) to 0.00181 (E90bd4b2f3645). It costs about 1 bit/weight on 3.1M weights. Moving the 2.1M-weight 5.o_proj and 9.o_proj to gptq_int3 should free about 4.2M bits, enough to cover it. Within iso_3.15 (E514ab09c524e).

proposals.name: r1_down14_up27
proposals.rationale: Two upgrades: 14.down_proj from rht_gptq_int2 0.00633 (E4c3f9b73e065) to rht_gptq_int3 0.00181 (E90bd4b2f3645), and 27.up_proj from gptq_int3 0.00572 (Ef04d8aa7bded) to gptq_int4 0.00217 (Efea8c18d2abc). They are paid for by moving four o_proj layers and 7.gate_proj to 3-bit. Base is iso_3.15 (E514ab09c524e).

proposals.name: r1_down14_up27_gate27
proposals.rationale: Same as r1_down14_up27, plus 27.gate_proj from rht_gptq_int3 0.00499 (Efa0bb391da67) to rht_gptq_int4 0.00153 (Ef428ac081334). The extra bits come from moving 26.o_proj and 27.o_proj to rht_gptq_int3. Other upgrades: 14.down_proj 0.00633 to 0.00181 (E4c3f9b73e065, E90bd4b2f3645) and 27.up_proj 0.00572 to 0.00217 (Ef04d8aa7bded, Efea8c18d2abc). Base is iso_3.15 (E514ab09c524e).

proposals.name: r1_down14_up3
proposals.rationale: Tests an early-block upgrade instead of 27.up_proj: 3.up_proj from rht_gptq_int3 0.00642 (E6f4f7ea296d5) to gptq_int4 0.00238 (Ef4ee8cb4969e). Also upgrades 14.down_proj from 0.00633 (E4c3f9b73e065) to 0.00181 (E90bd4b2f3645). Paid for by the same 3-bit moves as r1_down14_up27. Base is iso_3.15 (E514ab09c524e).
